messages:
maria: Heads-up — noticed a small cohort of requests with `X-API-Version: 2` still landing on v1 in eu-west and us-east.
ajay: Can you paste an example of the raw request/headers we saw?
maria: Sure, grabbed from the edge logs:
```
:method: POST
:path: /v1/generate
host: api.redwood.ai
authorization: Bearer tkn_***
X-API-Version: 2
Cache-Status: HIT from-edge
Forwarded: for=203.0.113.12;proto=https
```
sam: Huh. `Cache-Status: HIT` stands out. Edge cache may be normalizing/stripping custom headers on cached responses which breaks our header-based routing.
violet: That explains why the console shows those tokens billed to v1 — telemetry attributed by routed backend. Tenants hit their v2 quotas but appear under v1 usage.
maria: Impact looks limited (~0.4% of requests) but clustered by region and CDN POPs. Some enterprise customers pinged support.
ajay: Quick mitigation idea: have the edge rewrite add a safe header the proxy preserves, e.g. `X-Redwood-Version-Override: 2` and make router prefer that header before fallback.
sam: +1 short term. Long term we should not rely solely on client headers for routing; token-scoped routing or handshake in auth layer is more robust.
violet: Telemetry ask: can we reprocess affected logs to reassign those traces to the intended version? Need console patch to show reattributed traffic and a banner for impacted time window.
ops-bot: Incident note created: INC-2025-1123 - version-signal-drop due to CDN header normalization. Assigned: @maria, @ajay, @sam.
maria: I'll open an edge rule PR to set `X-Redwood-Version-Override` for requests where `X-API-Version` exists but Cache-Status=HIT. Plan to roll regionally: 5% -> 25% -> 100%.
ajay: Rollout guard: sample 1k requests / minute and assert mismatch_rate < 1% before escalating. Add automatic rollback if rate > 2%.
sam: I'll add a temporary dashboard (route_version_mismatch) and an alert (SEV3) for the rollout window. Also will increase trace sampling from 0.1% to 5% for the affected POPs for 6 hours.
deploy-bot: deploy queued by maria: edge-rule/version-override-2025 to eu-west-1 at 1758884500
violet: We should also draft a short customer note for tenants with observed billing attribution differences, and include a console banner for the affected interval.
maria: Agreed. I'll handle PR + rollout and a short console note. I'll ping @support with a stub message.
ajay: Afterwards let's discuss auth-layer handshake change: embed version claim in signed token metadata so CDN can't drop it.
maria: Sounds good. I'll circle back with timestamps for rollouts and link to the PR.
sam: Thanks — I'll get the dashboard + alerts ready now. :+1:
maria: :thumbsup:
